titre_video: Why You Don't Want to Earn $150,000 to $250,000
titre: Working class and six-figure earners are in the same boat
resume: Lower-income Americans feel resentment at a system leaving them behind; it is aimed mostly at the 1%, but since few know a billionaire it lands on six-figure professionals. The narrator argues the working class and six-figure earners are both far from the 1%, and the dividing line is how you make money, with traditional paychecks making both targets of a changed tax system.
texte: Among lower-income Americans, a deep resentment and anger at a system they feel is leaving them behind has emerged. While it’s mostly aimed at the 1%, most people don’t know a billionaire. So that frustration gets aimed elsewhere… and the 6 figure professional is often in the crosshairs. People are quick to laugh and scoff that a high level professional could struggle. The working class and the 6 figure earner are stuck in the same boat. Even if they don’t admit it. While one sits in an office and the other works a trade, they’re both lightyears away from the 1%. The dividing line isn’t how much you make, it’s how you make it. Because both groups survive on traditional paychecks, they are targets for a tax system that has subtly changed. And that’s left anyone trading time for money out in the cold. And it all happened without anyone noticing… at least at first.
